pages.text: Dragon Root is a status effect that makes affected Dragons hostile towards other nearby dragons for the effects duration. $(br2)It can be cured by right clicking on an afflicted dragon with a Dragon Root Remedy.
pages.title: Basic Information

pages.text: When a susceptible Dragon initially acquires the Dragon Root Effect they become hostile to any nearby dragons that are also susceptible to the effect. $(br2)The affected dragon remains hostile for the duration of the effect unless cured by right clicking on an afflicted dragon with a Dragon Root Remedy.
pages.title: Effect Information
